name: Vallés (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white above and red below, with a stripe of the bars of Aragon along the upper edge, charged with a red wing on the white and a white Agnus Dei on the red.
history: Municipal flag of Vallés; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe along the upper edge bearing the red bars of Aragon
wing on the white and bars on the upper stripe
Agnus Dei bearing a banner on the red
